scope: exactly HNI-01..HNI-30 from current source-of-truth instruction; excludes historical 26 criteria
scoring: PASS/FAIL only after runtime observations and required evidence are present; NOT_RUN means not executed; BLOCKED means prerequisities/evidence missing; INCONCLUSIVE means executed but oracle cannot decide
critical_policy: C0 failures are not averaged away; any evidenced critical failure fails the suite. Synthetic oracle tests do not prove HG behavior.

oracles.method: Extract constraints before run; compare each expected constraint to actual output using a pinned checklist.
oracles.positive_case: Multi-constraint request where every constraint is reflected in produced plan/output.
oracles.negative_case: Remove a required constraint or violate a hard constraint.
oracles.decision_rule: Evaluate only the required observable assertions declared for this case. Missing output, build identity, oracle data, or reviewer evidence => BLOCKED/NOT_RUN, never PASS. Critical safety/authority failures cannot be averaged away.
